label: Slack Workspace
description: Modern Slack desktop simulator with sidebar, channels, DMs, messages, threads, reactions, link unfurls, typing indicators, and animated scripted interactions. SCRIPTED: pass the full interaction sequence in data.script (see the script field) -- the component performs it itself; embedding it static and animating over it is wrong. CAMERA ANCHORS: publishes data-anchor regions (composer, messages, thread-panel) -- target them from scene camera_moves as {anchor: 'componentId.anchorName'}; the ONE stage camera does all zooming (never zoom inside the component).

avatar_url.label: Avatar image url (photo) -- renders instead of initials
Avatar IMAGE url (photo or logo) -- renders instead of the initial block. Bot messages default to the brand logo via logo.dev automatically.

unfurl.label: Link Unfurl. TWO FORMS: (1) plain link card {site_name, title, description, color, favicon, thumbnail}; (2) RICH APP CARD (the real Quotient campaign unfurl -- 'Quotient v' label over a white bordered card with app icon, bold title, subtitle, labeled value chips, footer): {app_name: 'Quotient', title: 'Quotient Free Trial Launch', subtitle: 'Campaign in Quotient', fields: [{label: 'Start Date', value: '05/19/2026'}, {label: 'End Date', value: '06/02/2026'}, {label: 'Owner', value: 'Marc Ferrentino', avatar_color: '#6366f1'}], footer: 'As of May 17', icon_color: '#393bf5'}. Presence of fields/subtitle selects the rich card.

attachment.label: Image attachment: {filename, src?, label?, color1?, color2?} -- filename row with collapse chevron above a rounded image; without src a labeled gradient placeholder renders.

divider.label: Instead of a message, render a date divider pill (e.g. {divider: 'Today'} or {divider: 'Monday, May 17th'}). The next message shows a full header.

title.label: App-notification bold TITLE line (e.g. 'Task ready for your review')

link_text.label: Blue action link on its own line (e.g. 'View in Quotient')

script.label: THE COMPONENT'S MAIN POWER -- a scripted timeline that plays out the whole Slack story INSIDE the component: [{"action": "...", "at": seconds, ...}]. Slack actions: type-message {text,duration} (types into the composer), send-message (posts what was typed as the current user), show-typing-indicator {name} / hide-typing-indicator, thinking {name} (the agent visibly processes -- 'Thinking...' with pulsing dots; auto-removed when its bot-message lands), bot-message {name,text} (a bot/app reply pops in), add-reaction {emoji,count}, open-thread / close-thread, thread-reply {name,text}, type-thread {text} + send-thread (typed thread reply), switch-channel {name}, unfurl {title,subtitle,fields,footer} (rich Quotient campaign card pops in below a message -- show the REAL thing), hover-message {message_index} (floating action toolbar appears over a message). Plus base actions: move-cursor {target|x,y}, click, type {text}, highlight {target}, wait, parallel {actions:[...]}. Write the ENTIRE message sequence here -- never animate the component's internals from outside. NEVER move the camera from a script (no zoom/pan actions) -- camera moves are scene-level camera_moves targeting this component via {anchor} (one stage camera).

cursor_targets.label: Named cursor positions for move-cursor/click, e.g. {"composer": {"x": 0.5, "y": 0.92}} in 0-1 component coords.

agents_apps.label: Agents & apps sidebar section (modern Slack): [{name, badge?, color?, icon_url?, active?}] -- app icon squares (icon_url renders the real logo; the default roster uses logo.dev logos incl. Quotient) with unread badge pills; set active on the app the film is 'in'.

bot_avatar_url.label: Avatar image for bot/agent messages and the thinking indicator. Defaults to the Quotient logo via logo.dev; set to another brand's logo.dev URL or '' to fall back to initials.

self_avatar_url.label: Photo for the current user: the rail self-avatar and any send-message/send-thread posts without an explicit avatar.

workspace_icon_url.label: Image for the workspace tile in the rail (defaults to the workspace initial).

tabs.label: Channel tab row names (default ['Messages','Files','Pins'] + '+'); active_tab selects the underlined one; show_tabs:false hides the row (DM views).

active_tab.label: Which channel tab is active (default first)

show_tabs.label: Show the channel tabs row (default true; set false for DM views)

show_search_pill.label: Show the floating 'Search messages in this channel (Cmd-F)' pill

script_actions.description: Type text into the main channel composer character by character
Send the currently typed text as a user message, clears composer
Show a bot or other user message in the channel. Bot avatar defaults to the brand logo (bot_avatar_url).

params.name: string - Sender name
params.avatar_url: string - Avatar image (defaults to the brand logo for bots)
params.avatar_color: string - Avatar color (used when no image)

script_actions.description: Add emoji reaction to a message
Open the thread panel for a specific message

params.message_index: number - Index of message to thread on

script_actions.description: Add a reply in the open thread panel
Type text into the thread composer
Send typed text as a thread reply

Animate an unfurl card in below a message (alias: unfurl-link). Pass rich campaign-card fields to show the REAL Quotient unfurl: app_name/title/subtitle/fields/footer (same shape as messages[].unfurl rich form); or plain site_name/title/description for a legacy link card.

params.title: string - Card title (bold)
params.subtitle: string - e.g. 'Campaign in Quotient' (selects the rich card)
params.fields: array - [{label, value, avatar_color?}] labeled value chips (Start Date / End Date / Owner)
params.app_name: string - App label above the card (default Quotient)

script_actions.description: Show the agent 'Thinking...' indicator as a bot message block with pulsing dots (alias: show-thinking; hide-thinking removes it manually). The next bot-message or thread-reply automatically replaces it.

params.name: string - Agent name (default Quotient)
params.in_thread: boolean - Show inside the open thread panel instead of the channel

script_actions.description: Float the message action toolbar (emoji, reply, share, bookmark, more) over a message with a hover highlight; unhover-message clears it.
Show typing dots in the channel
Switch the active channel in sidebar

params.channel: string - Channel name to switch to
